data.gender_notes: Arif is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-ر-ف (ʿ-r-f), 'to know'. ʿĀrif means 'knowing, wise'. Its root is ع-ر-ف (ʿ-r-f). A common Muslim given name. Arif is a Arabic name meaning “Knowing; wise; learned”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arif expresses “Knowing; wise; learned”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-ر-ف (ʿ-r-f), 'to know'. ʿĀrif means 'knowing, wise'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arif total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
